panels.title: Best Available Rate per Credit Score Bracket

targets.rawSql: SELECT credit_bracket, loan_type, company_name AS lender, best_rate AS "Best Rate (%)", loan_amount_max AS "Max Amount (L)", credit_score_min AS "Min CIBIL" FROM v_best_by_credit_score ORDER BY credit_bracket, best_rate LIMIT 100

panels.title: Lender Count Accepting Each Credit Score Bracket

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN credit_score_min <= 550 THEN '300-549' WHEN credit_score_min <= 649 THEN '550-649' WHEN credit_score_min <= 699 THEN '650-699' WHEN credit_score_min <= 749 THEN '700-749' ELSE '750+' END AS bracket, COUNT(DISTINCT lender_id) AS lenders FROM policies WHERE is_active AND approval_status = 'approved' AND credit_score_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg Interest Rate vs Credit Score Min

targets.rawSql: SELECT credit_score_min, interest_rate_min, loan_type FROM policies p JOIN lenders l ON l.id = p.lender_id WHERE p.is_active AND p.approval_status = 'approved' AND l.approval_status = 'approved' AND credit_score_min IS NOT NULL AND interest_rate_min IS NOT NULL ORDER BY credit_score_min

panels.title: Match Volume by Credit Score Range (Last 30 Days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN credit_score < 550 THEN 'Poor (<550)' WHEN credit_score < 650 THEN 'Fair (550-649)' WHEN credit_score < 700 THEN 'Average (650-699)' WHEN credit_score < 750 THEN 'Good (700-749)' ELSE 'Excellent (750+)' END AS bracket, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM matching_requests WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND credit_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(credit_score)
